antipatterns.description: Parallel fan-out fires before the shared prefix is warm or visible to the cache.
antipatterns.detection: Compare cache telemetry for a safe warm-up sequence against an immediate parallel fan-out.

antipatterns.description: Compaction, truncation, or summarization edits early conversation messages in place.
antipatterns.detection: Verify the system block, tools, and the earliest stable anchor messages survive context management byte-for-byte.

antipatterns.description: A dynamic tool set inside an agent loop rewrites early prompt content between steps.
antipatterns.detection: For each agent step, log tools_count, sorted tool-name hash, prefix hash, and cache usage fields.

antipatterns.description: Cache TTL, eviction behavior, or KV capacity does not match the request cadence.
antipatterns.detection: Correlate TTL, reuse cadence, KV pressure, eviction metrics, and warm-call TTFT.

antipatterns.description: Volatile content sits ahead of the reusable prompt prefix.
antipatterns.detection: Render a representative spread of requests and verify the cacheable prefix hash stays identical across users, timestamps, and request IDs.

antipatterns.description: Experiments, prompt variants, model settings, or router rules splinter reuse into tiny cache families.
antipatterns.detection: Bucket cache metrics by prompt version, model parameters, route, provider, and experiment arm.

antipatterns.description: Stable prefixes get routed across replicas, regions, or providers without cache locality.
antipatterns.detection: Track cache reads and TTFT broken down by route, provider, region, and replica per prefix family.

antipatterns.description: Template, whitespace, media, or SDK-path drift quietly mutates the effective prefix.
antipatterns.detection: Diff raw rendered payloads from every code path and pin one canonical renderer for the cacheable prefix.

antipatterns.description: Per-request salts or security isolation fragment otherwise shareable prefixes.
antipatterns.detection: Document the intended trust boundary and estimate the cache-efficiency cost of the chosen isolation level.

antipatterns.description: Mode switching or framework-injected metadata silently rewrites the cacheable prefix.
antipatterns.detection: Compare prefix hashes before and after a mode flip and trace where dynamic metadata lands.

antipatterns.description: Tool definitions, schemas, or serialized JSON shift between calls that should otherwise reuse cache.
antipatterns.detection: Sort tools and schemas in a deterministic order, then byte-diff rendered request payloads — or hash them canonically — across repeated calls.
